categories.name: Baseline (dF/F) fitting
categories.help_text: Which baseline models to fit and how the baseline level is estimated.

categories.name: Motion correction and filtering
categories.help_text: Lowpass filter cutoffs used for the isosbestic regression and noise removal.

categories.name: Execution and QC
categories.help_text: Parallelism and whether QC figures are produced.

parameters.name: dF/F methods
parameters.description: Space-separated list of baseline fitting methods: poly, exp, tri-exp, bright, bright-v2.

parameters.name: Baseline percentile
parameters.description: Fraction in (0, 1] or 'mode'. Applies to poly/exp/tri-exp only; no effect on bright/bright-v2.

parameters.name: Motion cutoff frequency (Hz)
parameters.description: Lowpass Butterworth cutoff used only when estimating the isosbestic regression coefficient.

parameters.name: Noise cutoff frequency (Hz)
parameters.description: Lowpass Butterworth cutoff applied to filter out noise.

parameters.name: Run serially
parameters.description: true disables parallel processing of fibers and channels (slower, but fit timings are precise).

parameters.name: Skip QC plots
parameters.description: true skips generation of the QC figures and quality_control.json.
